exposure: immediate postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) insertion
cohort: 140 patients aged 20-45 years who gave birth at Sughra Shafi Medical Complex Narowal between January 1, 2015 and December 31, 2015.
finding: Immediate postpartum IUCD insertion was found to be effective and safe with a low complication rate.
mod_finding: Expulsion and removal rates of IUCDs were significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group compared to the cesarean delivery group, and menstrual disturbance was also more common in the vaginal delivery group.
